Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: three-pose pixel-art tactical-map idle sprite strip of the SAME young village militia swordsman. Edit the supplied THREE existing poses. Preserve his recognizable spiky brown hair, youthful face, small plain short steel sword, unarmored peasant clothing design, poses, facing and stance. DO NOT invent armor, cloak, hat, shield, magic or new weapons. Three evenly spaced COMPLETE figures left-to-right on transparent background with ample margin, no text/shadows.
Change the color design to a clear ALLIED BLUE AND WHITE palette: muted medium denim/navy blue sleeveless vest, clean soft WHITE undershirt/sleeves and WHITE trousers, soft blue-white fabric highlights, restrained blue sash, dark blue/navy boots and belt. Remove the large brown/orange vest, orange sash and muddy grey trousers. Warm brown stays only in natural hair and tiny leather accents. Keep natural warm skin. Soft but lively colors: saturation only SLIGHTLY reduced, not washed-out, dull or grey. Use about16 coherent solid pixel colors, dark blue-charcoal outlines and simple two/three-step shadows. White must have a visibly larger share of the costume, readable against dark backgrounds.
Animation invariants: each figure has the same scale, identical head/neck/torso center and same ground baseline, with NO overall horizontal or vertical drift and NO body resizing between poses. Hair/face/chest should stay fixed relative to each figure origin. Retain the reference's three pose actions: pose1 sword angled outward to upper-left and wide planted stance; pose2 sword raised vertically at image-left and wide planted stance; pose3 sword vertical near body and narrower relaxed knees/feet. Only the sword hand/arm and knees/lower legs change between poses. Keep sword and hands anatomically connected, both legs/boots visible and unbroken. Whole figures are required. Crisp game sprite pixel-art, simple clean low-detail cloth, no glow, no blur.
